channel.title: The Evolving Soul: Writings And Lectures by Rudolf Steiner
channel.description: The Evolving Soul is a complete audio library of Rudolf Steiner's most profound lecture series. From the hidden history of Atlantis to what happens the moment you die, these readings explore karma, reincarnation, spiritual hierarchies, and the unseen forces shaping human evolution. Every episode is a full-length, unabridged reading of Steiner's original spiritual science lectures — covering life after death, Egyptian mysteries, the Bhagavad Gita, theosophy, occult history, and more. No commentary, no interpretation — just Steiner's words, read clearly from start to finish.
